Appointments made by the Governor of Uva Province

BY virtue of powers veste to me under Section 154 F (1) and (5) of the 13th Amendment to the Constitution of the DemocraticSocialist Republic of Sri Lanka, I, M. P. Jayasinghe, Governor of Uva Province, do hereby announce that I have made thefollowing appointments of the Provincial Council of Uva Province with effect from 22nd October, 2015.

01. Hon. Don Arthur Chamara Sampath Dassanayake- Minister of Finance and Planning, Law and Peace,Chief Minister of the Uva Provincial Council Education, Local Government, Power and Energy, Construction and Rural Infrastructure Development.
02. Hon. Rathnayake Mudiyanselage Kumarasiri- Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine,Rathnayake - Member of the Uva Provincial Council Probation and Childcare, Women’s Affairs and Social Welfare.
03. Hon. Akalan Senthil Thondaman Muththuvinayagam- Minister of Road Development, Housing, WaterMember of the Uva Provincial Council Supply, Estate Infrastructure and Co-operative.
04. Hon. Balage Saliya Sumeda De Silva- Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs, Tourism,Member of the Uva Provincial CounilTransport, Cultural Affairs and Textiles and Small Industries.
M. P. JAYASINGHE,Governor of Uva Province.Office of the Uva Governor,King’s Street, Badulla,22nd October, 2015.
